_comment: ICU's data for SIEOS's WebKit (docs/webkit-plan.md): everything but what the web does not need from ICU: languages other than English and French, legacy converters (WebKit decodes the web's encodings itself; UTF-8, Latin-1 and Windows-1252 kept), the CJK/Thai/Khmer line-breaking dictionaries and models, transliteration, spellout, confusables, character names, StringPrep.
